show saturday
scene sky
Good morning, Japan.
I had sex last night.
Which is something I can say about most nights, honestly.
But this was the first time I’ve gotten to do it with Niki ever since doing it with her sister. Which means I have finally unified their family and we can all go back to being normal now.
Chances are, though, this could just be a one-time thing as I work my way out of the dog-house. But it still feels good knowing things are on their way to resembling normalcy again.
Plus, I got to make her feel really good about herself after I only lasted approximately two minutes. I’ll have to thank Nodoka and her models for the assist with that, though.
Either way, if Niki is going to wage war on the girls of Class 1-A, it makes perfect sense that she’d want to assert dominance over them any chance she gets.

And what better time to do that than now, when she can stake her claim in front of everyone while subtly pushing away a lot of the girls who have effectively accepted they’re fighting a losing battle?
scene ayaneiotrivia1

But then, of course, there are those who don’t really understand that they’re in the midst of war at all because they keep mistaking gunfire for fireworks. And I’m not sure how Niki will handle people like that.
: Good morning, girls! And good morning to my totally platonic friend, Akira, who I have never done anything questionable with at any point in either of our lives!
: How specific.
: Sorry for missing your girlfriend yesterday, by the way. Your girlfriend who isn’t Imani, just in case anybody misunderstood that and is now tempted to get them fired. I’m talking about the idol.
scene ayaneiotrivia2

: Where’s she now, though? I kind of expected her to be here after hearing about the leash she had you on. It’s not safe to let dogs like you roam free, you know. They might take advantage of drunk girls or something.
: Ignoring how that isn’t a thing dogs have been known to do outside of illegal fetish material or hentai, I will say that I’m glad to see you’ve broken free, Sensei.

: I think I speak for all of us when I say that we were worried we might never see you again after your girlfriend showed up to directly challenge every single one of us at once. Bold move, I’ll admit.
scene ayaneiotrivia3
: Challenge you at what, Makoto?
: Could it be that all of you girls are also trying to become Akira’s girlfriends and that the only reason you aren’t as excited about the Niki thing as me is that you see her as competition?
: You’re not excited either. I think you’re just misinterpreting all the rage swimming around in your head right now as unbridled joy.
: I can assure you that all of the rage I feel right now is for Imani and not myself.

: Oh? Then could it be that she is trying to become Sensei’s girlfriend and you’re only pointing fingers at us right now to distract us from the potential extra-curricular fraternization of coworkers?
: Could be. I can’t give you an honest answer until I learn what “fraternization” means.
scene ayaneiotrivia4
: If you guys are going to stand there and riff all morning, do I have time to go get breakfast? It’s bad enough that Uta overslept, but now I have to answer questions hungry?
: If there even are questions, I mean. And that this isn’t just the opening to Miku’s skit contest thing and I misread the schedule.
: Are you even in this class? Who are you?
: Oops. You got me. I’ll be taking my leave, now.
: Stay right there, Io. You’re a part of this class whether you like it or not.
scene ayaneiotrivia5
: Why even add the “or not” part when you already know I don’t like it? Just get this over with already. I’ve done it before. I know the drill.
: You can do it, Io! If I can win at the trivia thingy, anybody can!
: Didn’t you lose?
scene ayaneiotrivia6
: You never lose so long as everybody has a good time.
: Yes you do. You probably just purged the loss from your mind since it was to fucking Yasu of all people.
: Why are you even over here? Your team’s cheering section is off to the right.
: I’m fillin’ in for Uta since she’s still tired and sad after tryin’ to pork Sensei’s girlfriend. It ain’t right if Io’s only got one person in her corner, ya know?
scene ayaneiotrivia7
: I think that’s exactly how many people Io wants in her corner, honestly.
: I just don’t get why we couldn’t do all of this online.
: Technology is poisoning the minds of today’s youth. And I will be damned if I let one of my nineteen favorite students fall victim to it.
: Is the twentieth student you forgot to include me? Because I exist on a plane much greater and cuter than everybody else?
: No. It’s Otoha since she’s the only one who isn’t in love with me yet.
: Stop stealing all the girls I’m attracted to and maybe it’ll make me like you more.
: Is it really stealing if he had them all first?
: Yeah, I’d say so.
: Stealing requires some amount of effort. And you’re unfortunately wrong to believe that this man would ever so much as consider partaking in such a thing.
: Wow, you’re sure all very fond of your teacher!
scene ayaneiotrivia8
: It’s almost as if you’re in love with him...
: Isn’t that exactly what Sensei just-
: Ignore her, Ayane. Rika does not possess the brain power needed to closely follow the threads of communication.
scene ayaneiotrivia9
: Hey, how come you call the other teachers, like...Miss Imai or Miss Watabe, but I’m just Rika?
: Easy. You’re not a teacher and I don’t respect you.
: Is it the tattoos?
: No, it’s the brain.
: What brain?
: Exactly.
scene ayaneiotrivia10

: Okay, Makoto can make fun of me as much as she wants, but the fact is that you can be a trivia expert without possessing above-average intellect! Which is precisely why I was chosen to host this event!
: I believe you were trusted with this one because it was the easiest.
: That’s what you guys said about the death ball, so I just don’t trust anyone anymore.
scene ayaneiotrivia11
: The rules are simple, though. Makoto and I are going to read some questions off of these cards and the two of you will answer them.
: The thing is, pure intellect will only take you so far because we’re going with my specialty here — bar trivia! So an assortment of mostly random stuff that will never really help you in real life.
: Unless real life lands you at a bar and it happens to be trivia night. I imagine this would come in handy there. Unless sign-ups were the day before. Or if you’re just shy.

: Or hey, maybe you are at the bar and you signed up for trivia and everything is going totally well, but then some guy’s phone goes off and it’s actually your daughter texting him about gorillas but, like, sexually.
: Are you done?
scene ayaneiotrivia12
: With what?
: Hah...shout out the answer if you know it. No turns this time. What was the name of the Grinch’s dog in How the-
: Max!
scene ayaneiotrivia13
: Oh, wow. I didn’t even finish the question yet.
: I mean...the Grinch kind of only appears in one thing.
: False! There have been a bunch of spin-offs he’s appeared in too. Like “The Hoobub and the Grinch” or “The Grinch Grinches the Cat in the Hat.”
: Are you some kind of Grinch expert or something?
: I am a Christmas expert. And there can be no Christmas without the Grinch.
: What the fuck is Christmas?
: Sorry. Christmalloween.
: Correct me if I’m wrong...but wasn’t his whole thing, like...trying to stop Christmalloween?
scene ayaneiotrivia14
: Yeah, but then his heart grew three sizes when he realized that the value of it comes from there and not all of the gifts!
: Plus, if you watched the 2000’s Jim Carrey movie, you’d know he was only grumpy because he was bullied in school and-
: Okay, okay. We get it. You like the Grinch. Next question please.
scene ayaneiotrivia15
: You know, Io’s kind of like the Grinch too when you think about it, isn’t she? Loner. Grumpy. Green. You don’t have a dog, do you?
: No, just a dead cat. Also, don’t talk to me. Next-
: Which shoe did Cinderella leave at the-
scene ayaneiotrivia16
: The left one.
: Bingo! Which brings the score to one point for Ayane, and one point for the girl who isn’t Ayane.
: I’m surprised you knew that, Io. That was really quick.
scene ayaneiotrivia17
: Oh, I didn’t. I just figured there was a 50%% chance of me getting the correct answer with a guess and that failing to answer correctly wouldn’t just give you the point since that would be unfair.
: Hey! Didn’t I say no intellect earlier?! Question three — which type of house cat is almost exclusively female?
scene ayaneiotrivia18
: Oh! Calico! That one I actually know.
: Correct. Point to Io.
: Ahem. I’ll be the judge of that, other girl I can’t remember the name of. Point to Io!
scene ayaneiotrivia19
: Does Rin’s mom have some sort of bias against flat girls with a green motif? Is Molly a part of this too? Is that why Rin rejected her?
: Uhh, I guess it’s my turn to read one? How many reindeer does Santa-
scene ayaneiotrivia20
: Eight! Nine, counting Rudolph!
: How many Christmalloween questions are there going to be?!
: I don’t know, but keep them coming! I can do this all day!
: That’s the spirit, Ayane! And since you’re the expert, maybe you’ll know this next one too!
: What’s the diameter of an average basketball hoop?
scene ayaneiotrivia21
: What? How am I the expert on that? I don’t play basketball.
: I just figured that Santa climbing through chimneys wasn’t all that far off from Lebron James sinking threes.
: I don’t know. A foot, maybe?
: It’s probably, like...what, eighteen inches or something?
scene ayaneiotrivia22
: It...is! Good job, Io! The girl whose name I now remember!
: Hooray. The anti-green stigma has been dismantled. We did it.
: Atta girl, Io! So long as they stop askin’ holiday stuff, you’ve got this in the bag!
: That one was mostly a guess too. I just visualized a basketball in my hands and tried to guess based on the size of that.
: Probably all that carpentry shit coming in handy. People good at that can basically just measure stuff with their eyes, right?
: If that’s true, there’s something I’ve always wanted to measure but haven’t ever gotten around to. Think you could help with that next?
: Maya, come on.
: Oh, as if you don’t also want to know.
scene ayaneiotrivia23
: Size doesn’t matter, guys! It’s just a pointless thing people focus on for no reason. Like UFOs. Or the age disparity between a teenage girl and the man she’s going to marry.
: Size totally matters and the idea that it doesn’t is just propaganda spread by a bunch of tiny-dicked rich dudes.
: Try putting AAA batteries in a AA slot and you’ll see for yourself just how hard turning shit on can be if you don’t have the right equipment to get the job done.
: You do realize Sensei’s still here, right?
: Sure do, but he has nothing to worry about. Platonically, of course.
: You can’t just add “platonically” to things to make them safe for work!
: Sure I can. This is my work. Do I tell you how to do your job?
: My job is loving Sensei. The only one who can tell me what to do is him.
: He’s paying you? How much?
: Can we-
: If I pay you double, will you love my daughter instead? I think you’d be a good influence on her and she’s very susceptible to blondes.
: I’m straight.
: That’s what they all say until they’re not.
: Can we keep going?
scene ayaneiotrivia24
: They say that too.
scene ayaneiotrivia25
: Next question — what is a single string of spaghetti called?
scene ayaneiotrivia13
: A spaghetto!
: There’s no fucking way.
: Correct!
: It’s Italian for “little string.” I learned it in a cookbook.
: I don’t like the implication here that a recipe called for a specific amount of spaghettos.
: Does this mean Sana’s only afraid when there’s more than one?
: I don’t think it’s the word that bothers her, Ami...
scene black
The contest drags on for another twenty minutes or so...and stays mostly even the entire time.
How the two of these girls manage to possess so much miscellaneous knowledge, I don’t know. But it’s made for a decently interesting tug-of war that, in its final moments, even Io is getting into...
scene ayaneiotrivia26
: Okay...with a score of 49-49, I think it’s probably best if we end this contest after the next question.
: I think that’s a good call. Imani’s been texting me to drag Akira over to the classroom for the next one for like five minutes now.
scene ayaneiotrivia27
: Well, that’s on her for not making sure we had enough time for this one.
: Right? Like, she said these are normally pretty quick, so I didn’t think it’d be a problem. But here we are down to the wire and it’s still anybody’s game!
: How we feeling, girls? Ayane? Io?
: Ready as I’ll ever be.
: Same here. May the best me win.
: You’ve got this, Ayane. But just know that if you don’t and that we wind up losing my dad to the second floor because of you, I am shipping you up there and replacing you with Kirin in Dorm 2.
: Please. At least Ayane leaves me alone.
: What do you think, Makoto? We’ve gotta give them a hard one, right? Wouldn’t be the finale if we just made Ayane name another Christmalloween thing.
: That’s already like eight of her points, so yes. Please no more Christmalloween questions.
: Hey, we gave you a bunch of sports ones to make up for it, didn’t we?
scene ayaneiotrivia28
: No. I only dislike advantages when they’re given to my adversaries.
: Just give us something neither one of us will know! We haven’t been stumped nearly enough.
: So basically, no Christmalloween and no sports? This one should probably work then, right?
: That one? Yeah, I guess that works. Do you want to read it, or should I?
: I can do it. So listen up. Final question...
: Which pop-ular Japanese seafood dish derives its name from the Russian language?
scene ayaneiotrivia29
: Anyone?
scene ayaneiotrivia30
: Uhh...well, assuming that your weird pronunciation of “popular” was some kind of hint...I don’t know. Ikura?
scene ayaneiotrivia31
: Correct. The word “ikura” comes from the Russian “ikra,” which is essentially just fish roe. Known widely for its iconic popping sensation, ikura-
: You good, Ayane?
scene ayaneiotrivia32
: Huh?
: It’s just a contest, girl. It’s not the end of the world.
